native-codex-review.disposition: Candidate Codex cohort. Vendor integration and runtime evidence required per product; this is not paid admission.

mcp-client-review.disposition: MCP/library integration review. Preserve the complete vendor setup; account for indexing, embeddings, memory and upstream MCP costs. Mock providers before activation.

opencode-cohort-review.disposition: Documented OpenCode integration. Requires a separate supported-client cohort, including same-model availability and provider accounting. Do not silently port to Codex.

claude-or-adapter-review.disposition: Documented Claude integration, with any explicit additional adapters reviewed individually. A Claude cohort or clearly labelled vendor-supported adapter needs its own admission.

ide-extension-review.disposition: VS Code/Cline extension distribution. IDE integration is a distinct cohort; source clients mentioned in prose do not prove CLI support.

standalone-transform-review.disposition: Standalone library/pipeline. Review a fixed transformation or vendor SDK cohort; adapting it into an agent changes the treatment and must be explicit.

research-observation-or-spec.disposition: Not yet an admitted agent optimizer. Source shows a generic agent example, log analyzer, research artifact, specification, fine-tuning experiment, or compression evaluation tool. Preserve in the full field and review applicability explicitly.

unresolved-upstream.disposition: withmewtwo/token-slayer is unresolved. No identity evidence for substituting an unrelated repository with the same name.
